verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, and publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or endpoint. The built-in Aleph Agent, its Slack tagging, the 150+ connectors and llms.txt do not let an external agent connect to Aleph over MCP, and no OpenAPI spec was found.
